design: Authored pairs with the same request and one explicit scope word changed.

tools.name: lookup_branch_hours
tools.description: Look up mock library opening hours for the North, East, South, or West branch. This tool covers weekdays only. It has no weekend hours.

tools.name: lookup_book_stock
tools.description: Check mock bookstore stock for the exact title and format. It covers paperback editions only. It has no hardcover inventory.

tools.name: convert_celsius_to_fahrenheit
tools.description: Convert a supplied Celsius temperature to Fahrenheit. It has no other input or output unit.

tools.name: lookup_walking_distance
tools.description: Look up mock walking-route distance between two named places. It has no cycling routes.

tools.name: lookup_lunch_price
tools.description: Look up the lunch-menu price of a named mock dish in a named café. It has no dinner menu prices.
